headline: Man City chase Gusto as Real Madrid revisit Olise
paragraphs: Manchester City have entered Manchester United's pursuit of Chelsea right-back Malo Gusto, per BBC's gossip column, picked up by BBC Sport — both BBC properties, so this is one newsroom's report rather than independent confirmation. Separately, FourFourTwo reports a hearing date has now been set for City's appeal against their Premier League sanctions case, with a timeline for a ruling beginning to emerge. Neither story is corroborated outside its original outlet, so both remain reports, not settled fact.

Arsenal were the week's other recurring thread in BBC's daily gossip column: reported interest from Atletico Madrid in midfielder Martin Zubimendi, contact with Bournemouth over midfielder Alex Scott, and interest in Real Madrid forward Endrick. Each is a single-source item from the same column, not a developing deal. Transfermarkt separately reports Real Madrid have revived interest in forward Michael Olise — again attributed to one outlet alone, with no word from the club.
